title: OpenRFM: Democratizing Frontier Predictive Intelligence on Relational Data
abstract: arXiv:2606.04320v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Relational databases hold most enterprise data, and predicting on them has long required hand-written feature joins and a model trained for each task. Relational foundation models (RFMs) remove this per-task engineering by predicting on an unseen database from a few labelled examples in one forward pass. However, the strongest RFMs are closed, and open RFMs pre-trained on synthetic data lag far behind. Prior work attributes this gap to the lack of real pre-training data. We find that much of this gap comes from an incomplete synthetic prior and from a sparse context. Existing synthetic priors lack history-dependent labels, so models pre-trained on them do not learn the temporal and relational dynamics behind real tasks. A bounded context also often misses the evidence that a task needs. We present OpenRFM, an open recipe for building an RFM from synthetic databases alone, whose data generator, model and training code are all op

translated_title: OpenRFM：让关系数据上的前沿预测智能平民化
translated_abstract: 关系数据库存储着大部分企业数据，长期以来，在其上进行预测都需要手工编写的特征连接，以及针对每个任务单独训练的模型。关系基础模型通过在单次前向传播中仅凭少量标注样本就能在未见过的数据库上进行预测，从而消除了这种针对每个任务的工程开销。然而，性能最强的RFM是闭源的，而在合成数据上预训练的开源RFM则远远落后。先前的工作将这一差距归因于缺乏真实的预训练数据。我们发现，这一差距的很大一部分来自不完整的合成先验以及稀疏的上下文。现有的合成先验缺乏依赖历史的标签，因此在合成先验上预训练的模型无法学习真实任务背后的时间动态和关系动态；受限的上下文也常常遗漏任务所需的证据。我们提出了OpenRFM，这是一种仅使用合成数据库构建RFM的开放方案，其数据生成器、模型和训练代码全部开源（原文此处截断）。
tldr: OpenRFM 提出了一套完全开源的构建方案，通过在合成数据中加入依赖历史的标签并扩展上下文，仅凭合成数据库就能训练出媲美闭源前沿模型的关系基础模型，实现了关系数据预测智能的平民化。
en_tdlr: OpenRFM provides an open recipe that closes the gap between open RFMs pre-trained on synthetic data and closed frontier models by enriching synthetic priors with history-dependent labels and expanding context, democratizing predictive intelligence on relational data.
